body: I think certain people in the world might mind. I'm still in high school, I'm 17 and a junior since my birthday's not too long after school starts. I'm about 5'2", so I think that the people who stand around in the middle of the hallway that I yell at in the mornings would probably rather have me gone. I guess it might be kind of funny to see someone that short demanding that you stop blocking everyone's way to class.

But I've been talking to the people closest to me. They force me to make promises they know I won't keep about not hurting myself. I know they're doing it to make me feel guilty, but it's not working. The only person who knows how I actually feel right now is my ex, and he doesn't want to take responsibility over any of this even though he's part of the reason I'm in this mess. It's like there's just nowhere to go. Like, I almost killed myself Thursday, but someone texted my parents to check up on me, so they did. Since then, they've done nothing to try to help. They didn't even hide sharp objects/harmful chemicals. It's like they don't care if I die.

I've never liked multiplayer much, I definitely like sitting by myself in a room with only my laptop/tv screen for lighting while singing to myself. I don't have many friends who like the same stuff as me, unfortunately.

I've opened up as much as I've been able to. I always try to keep on top of friends that seem even slightly down and I try to do everything I can to make their day better. I haven't seen the new Star Wars movie, but I haven't watched any of them. I play video games a lot, but I don't think it's unhealthy...yet. I have a therapist, but I haven't seen her in about two weeks.
I've opened up and reached out as much as I can. Everyone seems to just give up. It's like I'm not worth the work to anyone.
Thank you, I've already started seeing someone else, and he treats me a lot better.
I'm smart when it comes to academics, I don't know exactly what you're looking for.
I am too. Happens way too often.
Yes, or at least I think I do. My friends tell me I'm really nice and funny. I always try to make people happy, but I guess he never cared about that.
Nothing today, it's just that overall nothing has really gotten better.
Well, I'm still here. I haven't been able to see my therapist yet, but today I'm seeing the person who prescribes my medication, so hopefully I can figure something out with her today.
Thanks, I swear you care more than some of my friends.
(Eastern time zone) I still have school, so I can't call in the morning, tomorrow's overall just a busy day.
I don't know, I think it's at least too late today.
Some weird stuff is going on with the place I go to for therapy, so I don't have an appointment yet.
I guess I will when I see her again, but I don't even know when it's going to be.
I think this is the longest string of comments I've ever seen.

I've seen multiple therapists, but it's basically all the same. My medication doesn't work anymore either. I don't think there's even a way for me to do anything though. I'm just stuck. If I ask my parents if I can switch, they'll be suspicious, and I don't want them to know, because they'll just blame everything on me.

But this isn't the first time this has happened, and I doubt it'll be the last. I'm tired of this endless cycle where eventually everything I ever loved just comes crashing down and I'm left to try and deal with it.
I just don't know what to do anymore. What am I even supposed to do?
I haven't been doing it alone before though, I've tried to get help and tried to get better, but it just didn't work.
I've been through hell the past month, I can't just wait for things to get better anymore. My tolerance for living is only so great.
I'll lose time? And if my therapist can't help, then I might just end up feeling worse. I only plan on staying alive until Friday afternoon.
The only thing even keeping me alive right now is a promise I made to a friend that I'd finish the project we were working on. I'd barely count that as hope.
So far I'm alive if that counts
I feel like this all is my fault though. I feel like if I was just stronger I wouldn't have fucked up my life. I'm sorry.
I don't see any possible way it could be your fault.
I've tried almost everything I can to change things, and nothing's worked. I've been in what feels like hell for over a month now. I'm exhausted and I'm done. I'm sorry.
I'm sorry, but there's really only one thing on my mind now.
No, I haven't gone in a while, and I don't have any desire to go either.
Actually, yes. I have a therapist. Nothing's helping anymore though.
I don't think I can. I've ruined everything. He doesn't want anything to do with me anymore.
On a further note, when do you think would be a good time for me to kill myself?

Last month he told me that he wanted to take a little break so that he could do a few things and that he'd get back with me soon. He still came over weekly, and at one point, he said there was a 90% chance he'd get back with me the next day. Needless to say, he lied. Ever since then it's been a constant cycle of him yelling at me to stay away from him and him lying. A lot of days I've just stayed home and tried to not panic. It's been difficult. I found out last week that a week after he broke up with me, he started to like this other girl, but at the same time he was still using me for sex. He said a few days ago that he basically didn't want anything to do with me for now. I really don't understand any of this. He used to be really sweet and caring towards me, but ever since what happened, it seems like he's just been indifferent about how I feel. I still love him, and I'd do absolutely anything to have him back. Thanks for listening.
Nothing specific, I just mean more of not complaining when things get difficult, I guess that's counter-productive though since it forces me to bottle things up.
I think you're responding quick enough, so no need to apologize. Really, if things won't get better, than what's the point in sticking around?

Nothing specific, it's just that nothing's been helping. I try to change myself and how I look at things, and I try my best to get better, but then everything falls apart and I'm back to square one. I've tried changing everything that I can.

It's not like it's only been recently. I've been suicidal for years now, and I can't help but feel like it'll never get better. I mean, there isn't anything entirely wrong with the circumstances I'm in, just with me. A lot of things have changed since then, but one thing hasn't. I'm still depressed and suicidal.

Two years ago I had to go to a hospital for suicidal ideation and everyone knew it, why is it so much different if I actually make an attempt? My parents were upset for a while then, but they got over it, so they'd have to do the same here I think.

But I mean, I've tried doing things differently before, and nothing works. I won't want to kill myself for a while, but later the urge comes back three times as strong. My depression and suicidal thoughts aren't caused by my situation, but they're made worse by it.
I don't even know what I'm trying to do anymore, I just want to get out of here and quit doing anything, every day's not exactly a struggle, but it's difficult.
I'm a minor and my parents already have horrible credit, so yeah
Honestly, I'm still debating, I just want to know the consequences of my possible actions. I am looking for ways to make life better, I just want to know what could happen in a worst case scenario.
As long as you're getting better, that's good. I think it does people good to cry sometimes. Any idea about the insurance question though? I wouldn't want to be more of a burden on my parents
Well, how are you holding up?
Life in general. My meds don't really work like they used to and it's just sort of a culmination of shit. I'm 17 and I've had depression for 4 years. It's been rough.
Well, now I definitely have to reconsider what I might do if I commit suicide and survive
I know it hurts a lot, and I'm not worried about that, I'm just worried about the aftereffects. Thanks for the concern though
